title: Normal cone
statement:
For a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ with ideal sheaf $\mathcal I$, the normal cone is

$$
N_{Z/X}:=\operatorname{Spec}_Z\Bigl(\bigoplus_{r\geq0}\mathcal I^r/\mathcal I^{r+1}\Bigr),
$$

with projection to $Z$ and zero section given by the projection of the graded algebra onto its degree-zero part $\mathcal O_Z$.

Here $X,Z$ are schemes [def-pc-scheme], closed immersion means [def-weil-closed-immersion], $\mathcal I=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z)$ is [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and its powers are [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. The displayed graded algebra on $Z$ is the conormal algebra $\mathcal G$ of [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra]: its degree-$r$ piece is characterized by $i_*\mathcal G_r=\mathcal I^r/\mathcal I^{r+1}$ and $\mathcal G_0=\mathcal O_Z$. Thus the quotients on $X$ are interpreted as the corresponding modules on $Z$, with multiplication induced by multiplication of ideal sections. The relative spectrum, its projection, and its contravariance on algebra maps are those of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec]. The zero section is the morphism $z:Z\to N_{Z/X}$ induced by the augmentation $\epsilon:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G_0=\mathcal O_Z$, which is the identity in degree zero and zero in positive degrees.

proof.text: For the closed immersion $i$, take its ideal sheaf $\mathcal I$ from [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] and the powers $\mathcal I^r$ from [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Apply [lem-pur-conormal-graded-algebra] to obtain the canonical quasi-coherent graded $\mathcal O_Z$-algebra $\mathcal G$. Its statement gives $i_*\mathcal G_r\cong\mathcal I^r/\mathcal I^{r+1}$, $\mathcal G_0=\mathcal O_Z$, and the multiplication $[a]_m[b]_n=[ab]_{m+n}$. This identifies precisely the algebra in the defining formula, including its base scheme $Z$; no regularity or finiteness assumption is needed.

Apply clause (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec] to $\mathcal G$ on $Z$. Define $N_{Z/X}=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_Z(\mathcal G)$ with the resulting projection $p:N_{Z/X}\to Z$. On an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$ with defining ideal $J$, Step 1 identifies the algebra on $W=i^{-1}U=\operatorname{Spec}(R/J)$ with $\bigoplus_{r\geq0}J^r/J^{r+1}$; clause (2) identifies $p^{-1}W$ with the spectrum of this algebra. Hence this construction has exactly the relative-Spec meaning in the item.

Define $\epsilon:\mathcal G\to\mathcal O_Z$ to be identity in degree zero and zero on all positive-degree summands. By the nonnegative grading, the degree-zero component of a product $ab$ is $a_0b_0$; thus $\epsilon$ preserves multiplication, the unit, addition and scalars. If $\eta:\mathcal O_Z\to\mathcal G$ is the structural inclusion, then $\epsilon\eta=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal O_Z}$. Under the anti-equivalence in clause (3) of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-relative-spec], the affine $Z$-scheme $\mathrm{id}_Z$ corresponds to $\mathcal O_Z$. The algebra map $\epsilon$ therefore gives $z:Z\to N_{Z/X}$ over $Z$, and the identity $\epsilon\eta=\mathrm{id}$ gives $p\circ z=\mathrm{id}_Z$. Clause (3) also identifies its restriction on every affine chart with $\operatorname{Spec}(\epsilon_W)$, so it is exactly the zero section specified in the definition.

proof.text: On an affine U, the relative-gluing chart and the inverse image of U have the same open image and hence a canonical isomorphism. Apply the proved rees_associatedGraded_chart ring isomorphism. Its degree-zero representative formula fixes the structural ring map. Contravariance of Spec and the relative-gluing toBase equation give the required equality over U. No regularity, properness, or nonemptiness is used.

Apply reesConeComparison_exists, the proved normalized extended-Rees/relative-Spec comparison. Its normalization predicate contains projection compatibility as its first conjunct and zero-section compatibility as its second conjunct. Retain those two conjuncts and discard only the stronger degree-one formula. This proves purityNormalCone_comparison with exactly its original hypotheses.

lean.statement:
theorem purityNormalCone_comparison {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] :
    ∃ e : i.ker.normalCone ≅ PurityNormalBundle.normalCone i,
      e.hom ≫ PurityNormalBundle.projection i = purityNormalProjection i ∧
        i.normalConeZeroSection ≫ e.hom = PurityNormalBundle.zeroSection i
lean.note: The unchanged relative-spectrum construction is publicly reexported. The two additional proved interfaces identify the actual extended-Rees cone with it, preserving both projection and augmentation. Projection foundations are supplied by def-pur-normal-bundle through PurityNormalProjection, so the normalized comparison has no dependency cycle.
